card: Adds unit test coverage to verify that nBits remains fixed at non-retarget heights in PermittedDifficultyTransition. It addresses a specific surviving mutant in consensus proof-of-work validation code identified via mutation testing. As a small test-only change, it improves test suite regression detection without altering runtime node behavior.
problem: Existing test coverage for proof-of-work difficulty transitions allows mutations in non-retarget height validation to go undetected, leaving potential regressions in consensus validation checks untested.

risk.why: A mistake in this PR would only cause unit test failures without affecting production node consensus or validation code.

scope_notes: A small test-only addition (+10 lines in one file).
